title: The hornbill nest guardians

scenes.headline: In Arunachal, villagers guard hornbill nests.
The Hornbill Nest Adoption Program
scenes.body: Nature Conservation Foundation, the Ghora-Aabhe Society of village elders and the Arunachal Forest Department.

scenes.label: hornbill chicks fledged by 2024
scenes.body: From about 40 protected nests near Pakke Tiger Reserve.

scenes.headline: Why one tree matters
scenes.body: The female is walled into the nest hole and fed by the male. Lose the tree, lose the family.

scenes.headline: Wreathed hornbill: Vulnerable (IUCN, 2018)
scenes.body: Great, wreathed, oriental pied and rufous-necked hornbills live in Pakke.

caption:
Ten nest protectors, about 40 nests, 220 chicks.

Nest protectors are Nyishi villagers from ten villages who find, monitor and guard nest trees through the breeding season.

Source: Nature Conservation Foundation; BirdLife International / IUCN Red List; Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Named project with named partners and verified numbers. Media thin: no Pakke footage; the oriental pied hornbill clip is from Thailand (species does occur at Pakke) and is labelled by species only.
